description: Impulse by Velocity: run AI models on your own computer, on Windows and Linux. Load any GGUF model and chat with web search, files, charts and voice, let it use your computer, and serve it to any app through an OpenAI-compatible API and MCP. Momentum memory up to 32M tokens. No cloud.
